t: ok great. Now I see you referenced python as the runner for the project, but perhaps we should use electron. Go ahead and build the mvp, I'll test when ready @Claude-Fable

Built the Electron MVP replacing the Python runner. Main process runs the pipeline: streamlink+ffmpeg ingest (MJPEG frame stream + 5s wav audio segments), Claude vision labeler (structured output: scene/objects/events), Deepgram/Whisper STT, LaserData signal publisher (local bus fallback), FalkorDB graph memory (in-memory fallback), RocketRide action adapter (mock), Guild-routed persona crew (Strategist/Historian/Hype-caster/Scout, one Claude call picks persona + writes the line + memory notes + optional lookup), masky voices (browser speechSynthesis fallback with per-persona pitch/rate). Renderer dashboard: live frame, label tags, transcript, color-coded commentary, goal box, talk-to-crew box. MOCK_INGEST=true demo mode runs the whole loop with scripted labels and no stream/binaries. Smoke-tested the pipeline headless in mock mode: 8 label events in 2.5s, clean fallbacks; Claude calls fail gracefully without a key (untested live - no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the build env). PR opened off the open-session branch.
